# sidecar.process_partition { #healpyxel.sidecar.process_partition }

```python
sidecar.process_partition(
    gdf,
    nside,
    mode,
    base_index=None,
    lon_convention='minus_plus180',
    lon_col=None,
    lat_col=None,
    data_psf=None,
    cell_psf=None,
    combine_method='multiply',
    body=None,
    exhaustive=False,
)
```

Process a single dask partition and return DataFrame of assignments.

This is the core assignment function that maps each source in a partition to
HEALPix cells. It supports two assignment workflows:

1. **Scalar lon/lat columns** (efficient for strict mode): pass ``lon_col``
   and ``lat_col`` for direct ``healpy.ang2pix`` indexing.
2. **Geometry-based** (for fuzzy mode): pass geometries via ``gdf.geometry``
   for polygon-to-cell intersection.

In fuzzy mode, FOV polygons are assigned to all HEALPix cells they touch
using spherical polygon sampling. This correctly handles polygons that cross
cell boundaries, unlike vertex-only sampling.

When ``exhaustive=True``, fuzzy mode uses a two-tier candidate search
(``healpy.query_polygon`` / ``healpy.query_disc``) followed by exact
``shapely.intersects`` filtering to guarantee complete coverage for large
FOVs. This is slower but exact; the default sampling path is retained for
performance.

Supports multi-resolution optimization where the finest nside is computed
independently and lower nsides are derived by bit-shift aggregation.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                      | Description                                                                                                     | Default           |
|----------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| gdf            | GeoDataFrame or DataFrame | A dask partition containing source observations.                                                                | _required_        |
| nside          | int                       | HEALPix nside parameter (power of 2).                                                                           | _required_        |
| mode           | str                       | Assignment mode: ``'strict'`` (single cell per source) or ``'fuzzy'`` (all touched cells per source).           | _required_        |
| base_index     | int or None               | Base index for global source_id generation across partitions.                                                   | `None`            |
| lon_convention | str                       | Longitude convention: ``'minus_plus180'`` or ``'0_360'``.                                                       | `'minus_plus180'` |
| lon_col        | str or None               | Longitude column name. If None, use geometry column.                                                            | `None`            |
| lat_col        | str or None               | Latitude column name. If None, use geometry column.                                                             | `None`            |
| data_psf       | callable or None          | Optional data Point Spread Function. Called as ``data_psf(dx, dy)``.                                            | `None`            |
| cell_psf       | callable or None          | Optional cell Point Spread Function. Called as ``cell_psf(dx, dy)``.                                            | `None`            |
| combine_method | str                       | How to combine PSF weights: ``'multiply'``, ``'sum'``, ``'min'``, or ``'max'``.                                 | `'multiply'`      |
| body           | BodyGeometry or None      | Optional body geometry backend for coordinate conversion.                                                       | `None`            |
| exhaustive     | bool                      | If True, use candidate-search + exact-intersection for fuzzy mode (requires ``body`` to be set). Default False. | `False`           |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                                 |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame with columns ``['source_id', 'healpix_id']`` and optional ``'weight'`` column when PSF is active. |
